=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: `summarize_scoped_impl_runs` function, while loop condition `while [ "$impl_summary_page" -le "$SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES" ]` and cap check `if [ "$impl_summary_page" -eq "$SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES" ]` | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
PROBLEM: The variable `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES` is used in the new `summarize_scoped_impl_runs` helper but is never defined anywhere in the repository — not in the step's env block (lines 946-951 only define `ISSUE_NUMBER` and `ISSUE_TITLE`), not in the job-level env (lines 385-426), not in the sourced `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` (which defines a different variable `FIND_LATEST_SCOPED_RUN_MAX_PAGES=5`), and not in the new code block itself (which defines `IMPL_SCOPED_RETRY_SECONDS=120` but not `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES`). The PR description says "It reuses `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES`" but this variable does not exist; the existing scoped-run helper uses `FIND_LATEST_SCOPED_RUN_MAX_PAGES` (a different name, value 5, not 10). With `set -euo pipefail` active at line 953, the first reference to the unbound variable inside `$(summarize_scoped_impl_runs)` causes the subshell to exit immediately with error. The `|| IMPL_SCOPED_RC=$?` catches this as rc=1, so the code treats every scoped walk as an "unreadable page" and never actually walks the issue's runs. The entire purpose of the PR — confirming the smoke issue's own Implement runs finished before failing — is defeated: the scoped walk never executes, and the step falls through to the inactivity timeout every time.
WHY: In production, when the terminal branch fires (all page-1 Implement runs completed, no PR), `summarize_scoped_impl_runs` is called. The while-loop condition references the unbound `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES`, `set -u` kills the subshell, `IMPL_SCOPED_RC=1` is set, `IMPL_SCOPED_UNREADABLE_AT` is recorded, and the step prints "a runs page could not be read — treating as unknown, waiting" on every poll until `PHASE_TIMEOUT`. The issue's own Implement runs are never checked. A genuine Implement failure would be masked as a timeout instead of being reported with the run ID and conclusion.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
